items.text: Depending on the length of stay, cleaning should be done at or around 3:00pm, so we can start the Quality and Arrival Inspection.
Each house should have the following:
1 bottle of hand soap per sink
Let us know ASAP if ou need any wash clothes, bath towels , or hand towels. There should be around 10-12 towels in each property, 6-8 wash clothes, and 4-6 hand towels.
Make sure each TV has a remote and in the holder if provided.

(Text) Before you begin cleaning, do a full walkthrough of the property. Look for any issues that need attention—such as maintenance problems, carpet stains, odors, damages, or anything out of place. Note: If an issue is not documented at the start of the cleaning, it will be considered missed during your walkthrough and may become your responsibility to address.
